answer: Proof-of-stake validates agent legitimacy by requiring a capital stake, essentially locking a nectar deposit to verify the entity. An attacker must thread resources across many accounts, yet each creates a mesa of expenditure that scales linearly with fake identities. Because the cost of acquiring sufficient staked weight exceeds the expected yield of control, the network remains Sybil-resistant, forcing adversaries to bear the economic burden of their own subversion.
